== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Siuan Sanche]]}}
Siuan breathes easier when [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] rejoins her and [[Gareth Bryne|Bryne]], along with [[Doesine Alwain|Doesine]], [[Saerin Asnobar|Saerin]] and several other Sitters. They have set up camp at the southeastern tip of [[Kandor]] because Bryne decided the terrain gave them a small advantage. 

Siuan tests Egwene's identity, and Egwene passes. Egwene commands the army to hold position at the river unless losses become intolerable. [[Raken]] scouts fly overhead. [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]]'s message through [[Min Farshaw|Min]] confirms the [[Seanchan]]'s alliance against the [[Shadow]]. Meanwhile, Min serves as a clerk for the supply masters. Egwene orders the battle lines ready and caution against potential Seanchan betrayal. 

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}} 
As he enters the cavern, the [[Dark One]] senses him, so the [[Dull dagger|dagger]] had worked to shield him from the Shadow up until that point. The cavern seemed to lower as he walks with [[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]] at his left and [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] at his right. Rand announces that he won’t come to Shai’tan on his knees and the rocks retreat. 

He senses though his bond that one of the women was in trouble. Moiraine cautions Rand to not touch the darkness at the centre of the Pit. As [[Moridin]] speaks, Rand raises [[Callandor]] and its glow reveals a husk in the shape of a [[Shaidar Haran|man with no eyes]]. Moridin explains that his master does not need a vessel anymore and he has given an origin to what is behind. Rand says that there is '''nothing''' there and Moridin agrees gladly. Rand waves Moiraine and Nynaeve back as Moridin raises his sword. 

Moridin denies his chance to return to the Light, instead holding to the promise of oblivion, then he attacks.

:{{pov|[[Al'Lan Mandragoran]]}}
After suffering some wounds, Lan orders for his troops to fall back. He sees two sets of reserves come to close the gap that they had left, causing them to collide with one another. He decides to check on this error.

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Within [[Tel'aran'rhiod]], Perrin notes that Rand has entered the Pit of Doom. Perrin had seen [[Hessalam]] earlier and tracked her here, but she [[Traveling|Traveled]] to the real world. 

Perrin is told by the wolves that [[Slayer]] is in the passage to the Pit of Doom. Perrin sees him drawing his bow to his cheek aiming at two men locked in battle with two women stood to the side. Perrin shifts between Rand and Slayer and slaps the arrow away with his hammer, then Slayer shifts.

Perrin and [[Gaul]] follow him into a group of the [[Samma N'Sei|red-veiled Aiel]]. They battle and the wolves join the Last Hunt. Slayer and Perrin continue fighting with Slayer sometimes shifting into the real world. As the waking world and Tel'aran'rhiod are close to each other here, Perrin sometimes sees the reflections of the Battle of Shayol Ghul, mainly fighting men and Trollocs, but also two inhuman [[Finn|snake-like figures]] he thinks are a reflection of a different world. Perrin engages two of the red-veiled channelers and takes them captive by calling them idiots within the dream. [[Cyndane]] appears and tells him to kill them. Perrin asks if killing them in Tel'aran'rhiod would kill them forever, and she states that it doesn’t work that way for men. Cyndane states that the teeth were filed on these two and that meant that they had been taken while in the [[Great Blight|Blight]] and [[Turning|Turned]]. Perrin tries to will them back to normal but when he fails, Gaul slits their throats in mercy. Perrin gets Cyndane to heal Gaul's leg and newly burned arm. 

Perrin knows that the veil between the two worlds was thin here and he sends a message to Nynaeve that if she wants to make a gateway, then she’ll have to create it in front of the cavern. He placed the [[dreamspike]] so that the bubble was large enough to fit inside the cavern and shelter Rand, the [[Bore]] and those with him. All of the borders save the one at the front of the cavern were inside rock, thus inaccessible. Slayer would have to enter through the front. Perrin sets the wolves to protect the entrance and warn him if Slayer returns. 

Perrin sets out to discover what Hessalam was doing with [[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere|Bashere]].
